days.title: Natural Monuments and Ancient Paths
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Cueva Huerta
stops.detail: The valleys are formed by the basins of the Taja River, the Valdecarzana River, and the Val de Sampedro or Páramo River, in the latter of which the natural monument of Cueva Huerta is located.

stops.name: Puertos de Marabio
stops.detail: Natural monument of the Puertos de Marabio.

stops.name: Camino Real del Puerto de la Mesa
stops.detail: Also present in this park is the Camino Real del Puerto de la Mesa, a Roman road built upon a path already used by the first inhabitants of the area.

days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Abrigos Rupestres de Fresnedo
stops.detail: It is an area of great archaeological value, highlighting the Fresnedo Rock Shelters, near the village of Fresnedo (Teverga), the hillforts of Focella and Barrio (Teverga) or Ricabo and El Collao (Quirós).

stops.name: lago El Llegu
stops.detail: Of these latter types, those in the area of Lake El Llegu in Lena stand out.
